name: SEC Cybersecurity Risk Management, Strategy, Governance, and Incident Disclosure Rules (Regulation S-K Item 106; Form 8-K Item 1.05; Form 10-K Item 1C / Form 20-F / Form 6-K for foreign private issuers)
description: The SEC Cybersecurity Disclosure Rules (final rule 33-11216/34-97989, July 2023, in effect since late 2023/mid-2024) are a public-company DISCLOSURE regime, not a prescriptive security-controls standard: they require timely Form 8-K Item 1.05 reporting of material cyber incidents (within 4 business days of the materiality determination) and annual Reg S-K Item 106 / Form 10-K Item 1C descriptions of cyber risk-management processes and board/management governance. jurisdiction: United States (SEC-registered public companies / Exchange Act registrants, including foreign private issuers)
regime_version: Final rule Release Nos. 33-11216; 34-97989 (adopted July 26, 2023; effective Sept 5, 2023). Item 106 effective for FY ending on/after Dec 15, 2023; Form 8-K Item 1.05 effective Dec 18, 2023 (June 15, 2024 for smaller reporting companies). In effect as of 2026-06-01.
